versions.text: Criterion: Verify that allowable Levels for Air Vehicle Extreme States have been defined and assessed for safety of flight. Standard: The air vehicle meets the standards within MIL-STD-1797, 5.1.1.2 Allowable Levels for Air Vehicle Extreme States. Table VIII is completed. Method of Compliance: Verification methods include analysis, simulation, and inspection of requirements, design, and configuration documentation.
